title: A Cooking Class
description: Four recordings about a children's cooking class: booking, a chef's talk, tasting and a message.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Booking a class
parts.intro: You will hear Lan phoning a cooking school.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Good morning. Sunshine Cooking School. Tom speaking.

script.speaker: Lan
script.text: Hello. I'd like to book a cooking class for my brother, please. He's ten.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Of course. We have a class on Saturday morning at ten o'clock. Oh, sorry, I mean Sunday. The Saturday class is full.

script.speaker: Lan
script.text: Sunday is fine. How much is it?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: It's fifteen pounds, and that includes all the food. The children make a pizza and take it home.

script.speaker: Lan
script.text: Wonderful. Does he need to bring anything?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Just an apron. If he hasn't got one, we can lend him one for two pounds.

parts.title: Part 2 · The chef's rules
parts.intro: You will hear Chef Paul talking to the children at the start of the class.

script.speaker: Chef Paul
script.text: Welcome, everyone! Before we start, here are three rules. First, wash your hands with soap. Second, tie back your long hair.

script.speaker: Chef Paul
script.text: Third, never use a knife on your own. Ask a helper, and we will cut the vegetables together.

script.speaker: Chef Paul
script.text: For the dough, you need flour, warm water, a little salt and some yeast. Mix it for ten minutes.

script.speaker: Chef Paul
script.text: Then we leave the dough for one hour. It becomes soft and big. While we wait, we will make the tomato sauce.

script.speaker: Chef Paul
script.text: At the end, we put the pizza in the oven for twenty minutes. Be careful. The oven is very hot!

parts.title: Part 3 · Tasting
parts.intro: You will hear Mai and Nam tasting their pizza.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Mmm, Nam, your pizza smells great! What did you put on it?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Cheese, tomatoes and sweet corn. I don't like mushrooms, so I didn't use any.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I put mushrooms and ham on mine. Can I try a little of yours?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Of course. Oh no, I think I used too much salt in the dough.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: It's not bad. It's just a bit salty. Try mine.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Wow, it's delicious! Which is your favourite part of the lesson?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Making the dough, because it's like playing with clay. And you?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Eating it, of course!

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I'm going to make this pizza again at home. My mum loves cheese, so I'll put lots on hers.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Good idea. I'll make one for my dad, but with less salt this time!

parts.title: Part 4 · A message from the school
parts.intro: You will hear a voicemail from the teacher, Chef Rosa.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Hello, everybody. This is Chef Rosa. Thank you for coming to our class. You all made wonderful pizzas!

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Next week, we will make chocolate cakes. The class is on Sunday at two o'clock, not in the morning.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: Please bring a plastic box so that you can carry your cake home. And please tell me if you can't eat eggs or nuts.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: After the class, there is a small cooking competition for the best cake. The winner will get a free cook book. Everyone else will get a small certificate, so nobody goes home with nothing.

script.speaker: Chef Rosa
script.text: If you have any questions, please phone the school office. See you soon!
